messages:
maria_support: Hey team — customer Acme Labs on a support call reports their org dashboard shows 250 trial credits but our billing API and invoices show 0 applied for their project. They provided these quick checks:

GET /v1/accounts/ACME-ORG/credits -> 200
{
  "credit_balance": 250
}

GET /v1/usage?project=acme-prod -> 200
{
  "total_charges": 0,
  "applied_credits": 0
}

Customer is on the line in ~45m. Can someone triage?

alex_b: oncall-eng here, I can take first pass. @maria_support please drop org_id, project_id, and a sample service key (masked) so we can repro locally. Also screenshots of the org dashboard billing panel if available.

maria_support: org_id: org_01ACME, project_id: project_acme_prod, service_key: sk-live-********abcd, billing_account_id (console): bill_9001. Screenshot uploaded to the ticket. No invoice lines for the trial period.

jon_eng_oncall: quick hypothesis: credits exist on org ledger but allocation rules haven’t bound credits to the project because the project lacked a billing mapping. Repro steps I use:
```
# internal repro
GET /internal/billing/ledger?org_id=org_01ACME
POST /internal/billing/resync?org_id=org_01ACME
GET /v1/usage?project=project_acme_prod
```
Try running the resync and check allocation logs. If mapping missing, PATCH project to set `billing_account_id`.

ingrid_billing: started a manual resync for org_01ACME. Logs: 
```
[2024-08-05T16:02:12Z] resync: ledger found 250 credits, status=org_credit
[2024-08-05T16:02:13Z] allocation: project_first rule applied -> fail: project project_acme_prod missing billing_mapping
[2024-08-05T16:02:13Z] resync complete: 0 allocations applied
```
I can set the project billing mapping if we confirm this is safe.

alex_b: confirm. What killed the mapping? Looks like project was created via infra-as-code before billing account was attached. Safe to patch via API: `PATCH /v1/projects/project_acme_prod { \"billing_account_id\": \"bill_9001\" }`.

ingrid_billing: patched mapping and re-ran allocation job. New logs: 
```
[2024-08-05T16:07:01Z] project mapping updated: project_acme_prod -> bill_9001
[2024-08-05T16:07:05Z] allocation: project_first rule applied -> success: 250 credits allocated to project_acme_prod (ledger_id lg_777)
[2024-08-05T16:07:06Z] notification: billing webhook queued for account bill_9001
```
I also polled the public API:
GET /v1/usage?project=project_acme_prod -> 200
{
  "total_charges": 0,
  "applied_credits": 250,
  "credit_balance_remaining": 250
}

maria_support: Great — I just told the customer the credits are now applied to their project. They verified they see the same numbers in their dashboard.

jon_eng_oncall: root cause summary for the thread: org-level credits were granted but some projects created pre-billing-attach had no billing mapping, so the nightly allocator skipped them. Fix: backfill for affected projects, add immediate resync on grant path, and emit an alert if org credits > 0 but sum(project_allocations) == 0 for >1h.

ingrid_billing: follow-ups created: BILL-432 (backfill job for past 90d), INFRA-211 (prevent project creation without billing mapping), and ALERTS-76 (discrepancy alert). I've scheduled the backfill to run tonight.

maria_support: marking customer case as "credits applied" and closing the support ticket after we confirm the backfill results tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
